shots.name: tense
shots.prompt: An estate residents' AGM in a clubhouse hall in Lagos: rows of well-dressed Nigerian residents, one man standing and asking a pointed question with his hand raised, others looking at the committee table with doubtful faces. Daylight from tall windows. No papers with readable text.

shots.name: calm
shots.prompt: The same estate clubhouse hall in Lagos at an AGM, now relaxed: well-dressed Nigerian residents of different ages nodding and smiling as the chairman and treasurer at the front table speak calmly. Daylight from tall windows, hands relaxed, no readable text anywhere.
